name: Put SQUID to Bed — Deckhand
source: KB: squid-on-board-binder / §5 Mate Boat Checklist — PUTTING BOAT TO BED
intro: End-of-day mate cleanup. Start with onboard freshwater hose and soft brush, then switch to dock hose and medium brush once captain hands it over.

sections.title: Freshwater Hose & Soft Brush
sections.description: Use onboard freshwater hose and soft brush for interior areas.

items.label: Clean head — squeegee water off ceiling and walls (must be dry for cushion storage)
Photo of head after cleaning (optional)
items.placeholder: Document head cleanliness — ceiling, walls, toilet area

items.label: Stow cushions in clean, dry head
Clean fruit/veggie area and rear facing walls
Do dishes and sanitize cutting board with diluted bleach spray
Remove snorkel gear from deck, place gently on benches (protect Angela's varnish)

sections.title: Dock Hose & Medium Brush
sections.description: After captain hands over the dock hose, use medium brush for exterior.

items.label: Scrub and rinse deck with dock hose
Remove any HUMAN HAIR from the nets over the scuppers
Refill water tanks (use filter for STBD drinking water tank)
Secure stern lines TIGHTLY to opposite side stern cleats
Complete daily maintenance if it hasn't been done already
Final check: boat secure, clean, ready for next crew. Gate closed, boat pulled off dock, hoses stowed nicely
Check rack cards and refill if needed

completion.notes_prompt: Any supplies running low? Gear issues? Anything the next mate should know?
